verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage Mesh markets built-in AI agents for Customer Screening/Ongoing Monitoring and Transaction Monitoring. They auto-remediate level 1 alerts and escalate complex cases to humans, so users can hand off alert triage to an in-product AI. These are marketing-page claims of fixed-scope automated agents, and Starter Plan agent configurations cannot be customized. missing for 10: evidence of an interactive assistant users can give arbitrary tasks to, in-depth product docs on how delegation is set up and controlled, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Customer Screening and Ongoing Monitoring agent
high-risk or complex cases are automatically escalated for human expert review.
The agent configurations on the Starter Plan are standardized for all customers and cannot be customized.
